description: Dense jungle with bamboo and tall trees. A column of boxy tracked armoured personnel carriers with a machine gun mount, and helmeted soldiers in camouflage walking along a reddish dirt track. In the foreground two soldiers in camouflage helmets and fatigues bend over a folded paper map spread on the hood of a dark vehicle. One soldier's sleeve shows a patch with the letters ARVN. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.
reason: A visible 'ARVN' lettered patch sits on the right soldier's uniform sleeve, which is painted text. The art needs regenerating without legible lettering on uniforms or patches.
